title: Covers of (0, 1) that always miss a gap
caption: Each U_n = (1/n, 1) is open and together they cover (0, 1), but any finite choice stops at its largest n = N and misses (0, 1/N]. Here N = 5: the points up to 1/5 are left uncovered.
alt: A number line from 0 to 1 with four overlapping open intervals (1/2, 1), (1/3, 1), (1/4, 1) and (1/5, 1), and a gap (0, 1/5] under them that no finite subcollection covers.
description: The sets U₂ = (½, 1), U₃ = (⅓, 1), U₄ = (¼, 1) and U₅ = (⅕, 1) are drawn as rows.
Every point of (0, 1) lies in some U_n if n is large enough.
A finite subcollection has a largest n, here N = 5, and covers only (1/5, 1).
The points between 0 and 1/5 are missed, so there is no finite subcover.

checks.name: 1/N = 1/5 is the left end of the largest set U₅
